description.html: The 45 cm flexible air curtain is a Resun Air Curtain, in a pack marked for the 45 cm (18-inch) length. It suits medium-sized aquariums, where the bubble wall covers most of the back glass and moves the water along its full length.

A flexible air curtain is a rubber-like hose with tiny pores along its whole length. It can be shaped into a straight line, an arc or a circle, so it adapts easily to the aquarium. It is usually placed along the back glass or under the substrate, where it creates an attractive bubble wall.

The air stone connects to an air pump with tubing and breaks the air into fine bubbles. The bubbles move the water surface, where gas exchange happens, so the water gets more oxygen, and the water movement prevents stagnant zones and surface film.

Over time the air stone clogs with sediment and algae, the bubbles get bigger and the pump has a harder time pushing air. That is when to replace it. Keep in mind that a longer air stone needs a stronger pump. Fit a check valve on the tubing so water cannot reach the pump during a power cut. Rinse a new air stone in clean water before first use.
